stops.note: to seek out thoroughly, to acquire, from com- (thoroughly) and quaerere (to seek)
stops.meaning: to seek out thoroughly, to acquire

stops.note: narrowed in French to mean gaining control by force
settled as the English word for defeating and taking control of something
stops.meaning: to defeat and take control of a place or people

current_meaning: to overcome and take control of a place, people, or difficulty by force
